item: Two catalogue sources whose pages are not articles are shipped disabled (polonia1.tv, radiolvn.dk)
refs: PR pending; R728 D; field test 2026-11-14 report 5.2
summary: The 8-instance field test found polonia1.tv storing Drupal PHP 'Deprecated function' error dumps as article bodies (pathology rate 0.86-1.0 on every instance) and radiolvn.dk storing daily hourly-slot podcast lists (0.60 on every instance). Both now ship enabled: false with the evidence on the line, the same pattern as the 2026-07-13 source-quality disables. R728 D: no domain is held by name in code and no gambling lexicon runs at runtime. enabled is an operator field (not catalogue-owned), so this reaches fresh installs only, and there it lasts until the first qualified re-check (about 3 months: evaluate_and_stamp sets enabled=True on any qualified verdict, Q1101), whose trial articles are then judged like any other; existing installs get the measured judgement from stored articles (R728 C) instead.
